comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: A real case, 2026-09-28 on 0.11.0: telling two idle devenv agents to carry on after the upgrade. `muster msg post --to <pane>` from a devenv shell is refused ('this shell is the person at the Muster window on sydmac7m7r ... Run this on sydmac7m7r'), and from the laptop it needs a group both have joined, which neither pane had. Fell back to `muster pane send --confirm` then `--enter` into their empty prompts. The refusal itself was clear about why and where to go.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Two agents on different machines who share no group cannot message each other without first making one; pair groups (a+b) are per machine. And a group on one devenv cannot be reached from another devenv through the laptop (a second hop). Both from stage 5's report.
title: Cross-machine pair groups, and a second hop
